reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, product_name, unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE unit_cost_eur BETWEEN 50 AND 100
alternatives:
SELECT product_id, product_name, unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE unit_cost_eur >= 50
  AND unit_cost_eur <= 100

SELECT product_id, product_name, unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE unit_cost_eur BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00

other_way.sql:
SELECT product_id, product_name, unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE unit_cost_eur >= 50
  AND unit_cost_eur <= 100
other_way.tradeoff: Two comparisons give the same rows, but BETWEEN states the range in one short test.
